keyword: FDA bulk drug substances veterinary compounding GFI 256
angle: How GFI #256 compliance impacts veterinary compounding pharmacies in 2026
trending_reason: FDA's GFI #256 became effective in April 2023 and ongoing FDA compounding listening sessions in February 2026 are driving veterinarians to search for compliance requirements for bulk drug substances, certificate of analysis documentation, and approved BDS lists for office stock drugs
facts: FDA's GFI #256 allows pharmacies to purchase bulk drug substances from FDA-registered suppliers only if a certificate of analysis is included with the compounding record
Separate FDA-approved bulk drug substance lists exist for non-food producing animals, food producing animals, veterinary office stock drugs, and certain wildlife species
FDA hosted a formal compounding listening session on February 27, 2026, with ACVP invited to attend, indicating active regulatory discussions
The FDA requires compounders to report any adverse reactions within 15 days under current GFI #256 compliance requirements
FDA released updates to its List of Bulk Drug Substances for Compounding Office Stock Drugs under GFI #256 allowing application discretion for specific drugs required for urgent care
title: Understanding FDA Bulk Drug Substances and Veterinary Compounding: GFI #256 Compliance in 2026
